sets.description:
Cacao Ceremony

A warm cup, an open heart.
In this ceremony, we gather around traditional South American ceremonial cacao, shared as a gentle plant ally for connection and inner listening.

Guided meditation, embodied movement, and live or curated music weave the space into a soft ritual of presence. You are invited to feel, to breathe, to move as you are — letting the cacao open subtle pathways of clarity, tenderness, and joy.

sets.artist: Guided Meditation: The simple feeling of being by Günni
sets.description: Through the sense of that I am feeling we explore together this precious gift of being alive as human being.

TwerkFlow is a somatic embodiment movement ritual blending intuitive dance, hip-focused mobility, and emotional release, guided by Brazilian & Latino rhythms. Expect grounding practices, playful sensual expression, and deep embodiment—no dance experience needed, just come as you are and let the music move your hips.

Whether you’re looking for a festival buddy, friends for life, or something romantic—we invite you to get to know each other through honest, surprising conversations, supported by our question game “Talky, Talky” and the principles of “Einfach Knutschen e.V.” In our open meeting space, we’ll guide the conversation with questions that go deeper than “Where are you from?” and talk about listening, connection, and consensus. Everything is optional—nothing is required.
A well rounded  yoga classto arrive and settle into ease & the magic of Garbicz. With Dana Sertel.

TOTEM is a collective ritual-land-art experience where we co-create a living festival totem — a symbol of respect, power and belonging. Guided through a nature-based expressive arts process, you connect with your inner force and shape it into a collective sculpture built by many hands. Come to connect with the land, with your creative force and the power of community, and build the totem of Lichtung.

Tea Ceremony

Sit down. Slow down. Breathe in.
For one hour, we gather around hot water and leaves — sharing a quiet ritual of presence.

In a Chinese-inspired tea ceremony, high quality tea becomes our guide: rich taste, rising steam, the simple beauty of pouring and receiving. We drink in silence or soft whispers, letting attention settle into the now, one cup at a time.

Nothing to do, nowhere to get to. Just you, the moment, and the medicine of mindful drinking.

This workshop is a grounding and connection ritual where we soften FOMO and remember that support is where you call it. Through heart meditation, playful connection exercises, and a constellation-inspired group ritual, we experience what it means to feel resourced, seen, and exactly where we need to be.

Xōchiquetzal, the Mexican goddess of beauty, pleasure and joy, forces her way into Garbicz with her colourful cumbia parade to marry her beloved Baba Yaga. But first, she must win the approval of Baldur, the Germanic god of Light and Ordnung, who sets off in pursuit with his own musical platform. Their playful chase leads to the Loco Paraiso Stage, where more than 20 artists weave together Aztec, Slavic and Germanic traditions in a joyful wedding ritual, opening a weekend of reconnection through nature, music, and many wonders.

sets.artist: Retro Fit & Manifest by Katzi Schamens
sets.description:
A high-energy, feel-good movement session that channels retro fitness vibes, driving house music, and the power of positive intention. Step into a playful workout space where movement becomes celebration — uplifting the body, clearing the mind, and setting energy in motion.

With bold rhythm, collective momentum, and a touch of nostalgic glamour, this workshop invites you to sweat, smile, and manifest from a place of embodied joy. No perfection needed — just your body, your breath, and the willingness to move.

sets.artist: Breathwork & Tabacco Ceremony by Erich Joseph
sets.description:
Inside you lives a council of four: King/Queen, Warrior, Magician, Lover — mature inner resources that support clarity, truth, and presence.

We enter through Conscious Connected Breathwork, a circular breathing practice that opens access to expanded awareness and the body. Each archetype is anchored in your own way through sound, touch, and breath, while you remain in full control of your process.

The journey closes with a Rapé ceremony in a sharing circle. Rapé is a sacred tobacco-based medicine used for grounding and integration after the breathwork.

This session is trauma-sensitive. If unsure, please consult a medical professional beforehand.

**Please do not participate if you have:**
- Heart or cardiovascular conditions, high blood pressure
- Epilepsy or recent seizures
- Pregnancy
- Recent surgery or serious injury
- Severe asthma or respiratory infection
- Glaucoma or recent eye surgery
- Active suicidal ideation or recent psychosis
- Manic episodes (bipolar disorder)
- Acute PTSD crisis or uncontrolled panic
- Current substance intoxication or withdrawal

sets.artist: Release, Realign, Receive by Julia Labonte-Stoy
sets.description:
Release, Realign, Receive

Leave your heavy baggage behind and awaken your body's wisdom through shaking, conscious movement, and soulful coaching elements.

Together, we will explore the art of letting go what holds you back, embrace the unknown and celebrate the space we create for fresh energy.

Come exactly as you are and leave lighter, freer, and inspired.

RECODE Workout is a breath-led movement class designed to reveal how you respond under pressure. Through movement, controlled breathing and guided attention, you train the ability to remain calm, conscious and yourself when challenge arises.

sets.artist: Longevity Life Hacks by Andi Stollreiter
sets.description:
A grounded, practical session on how to support vitality, resilience, and long-term well-being through small everyday choices. Drawing on breath, movement, recovery, and simple lifestyle shifts, this workshop invites you to reconnect with your body’s intelligence and explore what truly helps you feel strong, clear, and energized over time.

Less hustle, more alignment. Less optimization, more embodied sustainability. A space to gather tools for healthy longevity in a way that feels realistic, human, and good to live with.

KABARET LILIUM is an immersive Berlin-based event series curated by artist Lilly Mortis. Inspired by the glamour of the 1920s, it blends burlesque, boylesque, live music, and eccentric performances within an intimate, accessible lounge setting.

Without a traditional stage, the space becomes a sensual oasis where audience and performers meet on eye level. International acts, interactive moments, playful encounters, and a shared dance floor merge into an experience of glamour, freedom, and radical joy.

A new gateway opens.

Our slow and sober mornings begin with acknowledging the mind-body connection and

cultivates liberation, confrontation, expression, and fun.

Communication under pressure
Why do we keep misunderstanding each other, even with the best intentions?
A practical workshop about how different people communicate, process information and respond to stress.
Less friction, more understanding, better teamwork.

A Breath & Sound Journey

An immersive journey where breath and sound become one. Presented by Spirit of Breath and friends, this experience weaves gentle movement, conscious breathing, and resonant sound to help you soften, release, awaken presence, and reconnect with your inner rhythm.

sets.artist: The Neuroscience of Raving - Dance as Medicine by Rave Therapy Girl
sets.description: Finally, a therapist who gets why Raving heals. Madison Liddle encourages patients to rave  as a way to heal trauma and connect with the rythm, in community. The dancefloor is one of the most powerful places to remember who we are.

sets.artist: Resonance Flow Lab by Colibri & Intiche
sets.description:
Recalibrate and balance body, mind, spirit, and the energetic system. Drawing from over 30 years of experience in organic music creation, Intiche integrates meditation, breathwork, movement, chanting, and flow practices to open creative channels and intuitive awareness.
An immersive journey into creative flow, presence, and inspired expression—beyond logic and mental control.

Science & spirit of FASTING
– Biohacking the Body ~ Expanding awareness
We'll explore how fasting is psychoactive,  triggers cellular renewal, sharpen the mind, elevate awareness, and reconnect you with yourself. An ancient spiritual practice meets cutting-edge longevity research in a journey that is as much about consciousness as it is about biology.
Discover why fasting deserves a place in your life—especially if you're a raver!
25 years of fasting and raving in one fun and interactive talk. With Q&A

sets.description:

party spaces sober – creating meaningful connections and cultivating a festival experience that
feels authentic, empowering, and fun, without relying on substances.
Through open discussion, personal stories, connection games, and practical tools, we’ll share
insights on managing triggers, handling social pressure, embracing the power of saying “no,”
finding your people, and discovering natural highs that support well-being.

PSYCHEDELIC BREATH® - Who are we becoming?

Eva Kaczor, the founder of PSYCHEDELIC BREATH®, guides you in an altered state that enables a higher perspective on your future.
With neuroscience, state-altering breathwork, electronic music and inspirational guidance you explore who you are becoming - and what you are here to contribute for the next generation to come.

Enjoy a high energy workshop imbued with mindfulness, deep connection with our selves and others, and a whole lotta laughs! Not sure? Fake it till you make it! Your body can't tell the difference ;-) Come as you are - no mat, special clothes or experience needed. Bring water!

sets.artist: DMT Decompression in the water- free diving static training
sets.description:
Free‑diving inspired static breath training in the water with former deep diver Rodhø will teach us how to relax underwater to helps us decompress, release and calibrate for a new day at Garbicz.

In this session, the water becomes your teacher. Through free‑diving–inspired static breath practices, Rodho guides you into deep states of calm where your nervous system can soften, reset, and rewire. Held gently by the element of water, you explore longer exhales, breath holds, and conscious relaxation, inviting the body to unlock its own inner pharmacy of DMT-like states of clarity and spaciousness.

sets.artist: Becoming BEST friends with our Genitals by Maxinne Bjork
sets.description:
This world doesn’t always offer the most supportive environment for building a deep, healthy
connection with our genitals. From limited sexual education and societal shame to unrealistic
representations of bodies, many of us feel disconnected from, or critical of, a part of ourselves
that deserves so much more love, care, and acceptance.
In this clothed workshop, through reflection, creativity, and shared experience, we journey
together into the depth of the magnitudes of carrying our deepest gifts behind our legs. Because
this is the foundation of experiencing the most profound pleasures of life, by truly accepting
ourselves, and discovering a genuine, substance-free sense of confidence and self-love.

sets.artist: High on Story by Vishal Jodhani
sets.description: Dive into a playful circle where we celebrate festival moments and share the stories that shape us. Together, we’ll explore our inner narratives and dig for the “gold” in our festival experiences—rewriting tales that hold us back and discovering new ways to connect, laugh, and shine. Leave feeling lighter, brighter, and woven into the magic of Garbicz. Come as you are; leave as your own hero, ready to dance a new story!

sets.artist: Temazcal Ceremony guided by Zohar (Meeting Point Sauna)
sets.description:
Zohar trained with Oaxacan Curanderas and has been facilitating Temazcal (Mexican Sweat Lodge Ceremonies) For 7 years.

For the Lichtung Sauna she would be honored to offer a 30 -40 minute experience which is a contemporary version of the Mexican Tradition where she will give a cleanse (limpia) and then people will dive into a meditative state reflecting on states an processes of life. The experience symbolizes a rebirth and participants will receive different essences and the sound of her native american flute while they sweat and contemplate.

This is a guided workshop (for female bodies only!!) to slow down, reconnect to your body through the senses, and open to deeper receiving. Through breathwork, embodiment practices, conscious touch, sensory awareness, and voice activation, you’ll learn to soften out of performance and into presence, pleasure, and self trust

sets.artist: Longevity - Tradition, Modernity or Capitalism by Dainius Guzauskas
sets.description: A wholesome workshop comprising of industry knowledge, alternative views and somatic (vagal) exercises for longevity in respect to body, mind and the spirit.

sets.artist: Talk on Psychedelics by Dr. Florian Lanzer
sets.description:
Psychedelics and the Hidden Cost of Performance

Some people never reach their life goals. Others do but arrive at a question none of their usual tools can answer. For more than a decade, Florian Lanzer has worked with founders, executives and creatives facing exactly this moment. In this talk, he shows why the path towards a good life isn't in adding more, and what's at stake if the psychedelic field gets the next few years wrong.
Hybrid DJ Set

Each knot becomes a gesture of gratitude, presence, and renewal. The process invites us to slow down, trust intuition, and experience how creativity can weave strangers into a temporary community.

We move with awareness rather than intensity, exploring balance, alignment, and inner support. Small gestures unfold into deep presence, inviting the nervous system to soften and recalibrate.

Open to all levels. Come as you are — and leave a little more connected.

sets.artist: Theater of Co- Creation by Rico Loop (live)
sets.description:
The Genius Is You!

In the heart of Garbicz Festival, on the clearing of the amphitheatre – the place where the Theatre of Co-Creation was born – we open a space where music is not only created, but discovered.

With voice, rhythm, silence, and spontaneous improvisation, we weave our impulses into a living field of sound. From many individuals, an organism emerges. Listening becomes resonance. Resonance becomes music.

There is nothing to be able to do and nothing to achieve. Only the courage to trust your first impulse. Because genius is not something you own. It appears in the very moment we connect.

Come as you are. Leave as more of yourself.

KU SOBIE - “toward oneself” - is a conscious connected breath ritual exploring belonging beyond identity, tribe, and inherited narratives. In a world shaped by migration, cultural tension, and belonging to others, we return to an embodied sense of home, we return to ourselves.
